mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish: expect overcast skies and 62 degrees at City Hall, cooling to an overnight low of 59 with no rain. The moon is in its first quarter, and the I S S will be visible tomorrow morning starting at 4:55 AM, rising over Mount Horeb and crossing high toward the Fitchburg and Madison area.

The City of Verona is continuing major infrastructure upgrades with phase two of the Mark Drive reconstruction project, which includes new utility lines and pavement. Additionally, the city is prioritizing a connected transportation network by installing new sidewalks and multi-use paths to improve accessibility for all residents.

There is plenty to do in Verona tomorrow. You can visit the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, grab pizza at Lake Lou-ee, join a yoga session at Insight Wellness, or head to trivia night at The Bogey Factory. Also, mark your calendars for Concerts in the Park this Thursday at Century School Park.
On Friday, a 44-year-old driver was arrested for an O W I after officers found her unresponsive in her vehicle near North Main Street and Cross Country Road.
Today's flavor is Caramel Chocolate Pecan. The store is currently closed for the night, but they will be ready to serve you starting at 10 AM tomorrow morning.
